geology_notes: Churchill Resources holds the Foxtrot past-producing antimony mine (Frost Cove / Black Raven property) in central Newfoundland, and has expanded its district land position through the March 2026 Golden Baie option (39,925 ha, TSXV-approved March 27, 2026) and a Black Raven LOI. Confirmed geological highlights from accessible disclosures: (1) FC25-27: 13.00% Sb over 0.57m at Frost Cove — validated after the May 2026 data-correction release that downgraded the broader initial assay dataset; (2) a second new polymetallic system at southern Frost Cove / Black Raven yielding 7.25% Sb over 1.98m; (3) a 20-vein Au-Ag-Mo-Pb-Zn swarm at Pomley Cove Pond with surface channel results including 17.3 g/t Au and 130 g/t Ag; (4) zinc grab samples at Black Raven reaching 5.25%, 11.03%, and 12.11% Zn with associated Au, Ag, and Pb. Nine 2026 drill holes completed circa July 13 remain without confirmed public assay release as of July 30 — seventeen days since the 'imminent' assay announcement; two targeted news-index searches conducted today found no results headline. The August 2023 NI 43-101 technical report remains the most recent on file; its first 60 pages yielded no compliant resource estimate. All five resource/reserve fields are null per extraction. Score of 3 reflects confirmed high-grade multi-commodity mineralisation across a consolidated NL property package, constrained by absence of a compliant resource estimate and seventeen days of post-drill silence on pending 2026 assay results.

This macro tailwind remains durable as of July 30, 2026. Company-specific catalyst (adverse development): CRI shares fell approximately 20% on July 15, 2026, closing near C$0.04. The specific trigger remains unconfirmed despite two searches and one (blocked) fetch attempt today — the Wealth Awesome article explaining the decline returned HTTP 403. The timing — two days after the nine 2026 drill holes were reported as completed circa July 13 and concurrent with an unannounced CEO transition — is notable. As of July 30, the 2026 assay batch is now seventeen days past the 'imminent' announcement with no results headline indexed. Score of 2 maintained: macro tailwind is structurally intact; the CEO transition during an assay-pending window, the unexplained July 15 stock decline, and seventeen days of assay silence together constitute accumulating near-term negative signals.
